command.name: local-model-supervisor-builder
command.command: codex exec --full-auto 'Implement only B0/Phase A from docs/reverse-engineering/vllmops-bare-metal-model-supervisor.md. Build an independently authored, dependency-free local-model-supervisor/v1 domain module with deterministic fake process, gateway and metrics adapters plus Node tests. Implement ModelRuntimeManifest, ModelPlacementPlan, ModelExecutionGrant, ModelProcessReceipt, ModelRouteState, GatewayRefreshReceipt and RuntimeDoctorReport semantics. Keep process existence, readiness and route eligibility separate. Unknown resource/metric evidence must remain unknown. ModelPlacementPlan has no execution authority. Use only fake adapters: no process spawn, signals, network, vLLM, LiteLLM, GPU probes, model downloads, shell, Git mutation or deployment. Preserve existing behavior and run the narrowest focused tests before returning.'

repairCommand.name: local-model-supervisor-repair
repairCommand.command: codex exec --full-auto 'Read $SHIPPING_CONTEXT_FILE and $SHIPPING_FAILURE_FILE plus docs/reverse-engineering/vllmops-bare-metal-model-supervisor.md. Repair only the failing Phase A local-model-supervisor gate. Preserve ownership, plan-vs-grant, readiness-vs-process and route-eligibility truth. Unknown stays unknown. Use fake adapters only; do not add network, spawn processes, send signals, access GPUs, install/call vLLM or LiteLLM, download models, push, merge or deploy. Run the narrowest relevant tests.'

goldenPath.description: A valid model manifest produces a stable canonical digest without persisting resolved secret values.
A placement plan binds the exact model and machine evidence and reports fit|degraded|refuse|unknown without granting execution.
Duplicate port or exclusive-device conflict refuses the affected placement with a typed reason.
Missing or stale memory/device evidence yields unknown rather than invented capacity or fit.
A model execution grant binds exact manifest, placement, machine and policy digests and cannot silently switch model/runtime/device.
Process existence alone never produces a ready route; readiness evidence is a separate transition.
Restart reconciliation distinguishes owned healthy, stale and foreign/orphan process observations without fabricating success.
Concurrent fake starts for one model are resolved by one bounded supervisor lease and do not create two owned executions.
Loading/stopped/failed route state is never exposed as ready and carries a typed route-eligibility reason.
Gateway refresh prevalidates new route state and records old/new route digests plus cutover and in-flight disposition.
Interrupted or failed fake cutover records interruption/failure rather than full gateway-refresh success.
Missing runtime metrics stay unknown and are never represented as zero.
A sleep-to-wake transition cannot produce ready until fresh post-wake readiness evidence exists.
Same-device co-residency is never accepted solely because two manifests request the same GPU identifier.
Doctor findings are passive evidence and cannot themselves spawn, stop, signal or authorize a runtime.
Receipts contain redacted identities/digests/references and never raw secret literals.

excludedFromRelease: vllmops source, TUI, branding or schema copy
real process spawn or signal handling
